pages.name: Chuhaister
pages.text: A giant of the forest. Tough hide, mighty blows and hatred for mavkas.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: $(li)Does not strike first: not until you provoke it.$(li)Attacks mavkas.$(li)$(#2E7D4F)Grows weaker near a Mavka Tree and a Titan Tree.$()

pages.title: What to do
pages.text: Do not provoke the giant without need. Not every foe must be defeated.$(br2)But if you slay it before the mavkas’ eyes, you win their favour: $(l:general/affection)more here$(/l).
